import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
state = json.loads((root/'__dewycache__/compact-core/current.json').read_text())
seed = root/'__dewycache__/compact-core'/state['binary']
trial = Path('/tmp/dewy-source-core/dead-nop-trial')
trial.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
shutil.copytree(root/'core/compiler', trial/'compiler', dirs_exist_ok=True)
(trial/'bin').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
if not (trial/'lib').exists():
    (trial/'lib').symlink_to(root/'core/lib', target_is_directory=True)
p = trial/'compiler/opt.jo'
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('    keep = fill(true, o_out.len())\n', '', 1)
s = s.replace('                keep[i] = false\n', '                o_out[i].op = .nop\n', 1)
a = s.index('    code: Ins[]\n    code.reserve(o_out.len())')
b = s.index('\n# ---------------- loop-invariant', a)
s = s[:a] + '    ir.code = o_cleanup(o_out)\n' + s[b:]
a = s.index('o_cleanup = (code: Ins[])')
s = s[:a] + s[a:].replace('        op = ins.op\n', '        op = ins.op\n        if op == .nop: continue\n', 1)
p.write_text(s)
env = {k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('DEWY_', 'SLOPPY_'))}
env['SLOPPY_EMIT_WORKERS'] = '1'
subprocess.run([str(seed), 'build', str(trial/'compiler/main.jo'), '-o', str(trial/'bin/dewy-core')], check=True, env=env)
print(trial/'bin/dewy-core')
